Processing
Current Commons Ogg is the 609-second version restored on 29 May 2026; an intervening version lasted about 631 seconds. Documented

The revision comment criticises processing on the superseded file. This documents an uploader’s statement, not an independent restoration analysis; no engineer, transfer date or processing settings are established. The linked upstream archive is unavailable.

[1]
Composition rights
Underlying composition public domain under the separate Commons composition notice. Documented

The composition notice identifies Tchaikovsky’s death in 1893; it is not the recording licence.

[1]
Recording rights
territorial — Commons explicitly applies PD-EU-audio to the sound recording. Documented

Programme rule 1 accepts this recording-specific European expiry statement; US status is not established. The linked Internet Archive item is dark: metadata returns is_dark:true, details returned HTTP 404 and metadata XML HTTP 403. A Wayback CDX request also returned 403. Therefore earlier upstream licence terms, including whether an NC restriction ever appeared, cannot be independently certified. No positive NC evidence was found in the available Commons record; unknown upstream terms are not represented as verified unrestricted terms.

[1] [2]
